stem.text: A displacement-time graph for a toy car is shown.

stem.alt: Graph of displacement in m against time in s, time from 0 to 10 s, displacement from -2 to 2 m; a line rises from the origin, is level, then falls below the axis and is level again.

stem.text: Which graph shows the variation with time of the velocity $v$ of the car?
